dialog.title: Commit
dialog.description: Compose the message with more room. Staging stays in the Changes panel.

staged.emptyAmend: Nothing staged — this rewrites the last commit's message only.
staged.empty: Nothing staged — stage files in the Changes panel.

blocked.directCommit: requires changes via a pull request — direct commits are blocked by a branch rule.

hold.none: Your changes will amend the most recent commit ({{hash}}).
hold.commit: The latest commit is no longer {{hash}}, so your changes can't amend it.
hold.branch: The checked-out branch changed since you started amending {{hash}}, so your changes can't amend it.

ai.stageToGenerate: Stage changes to generate a commit message
ai.connectProvider: Connect an AI provider to generate commit messages
ai.nothingStaged: Nothing is staged — stage some changes first.

emptyStaged.patterns: All staged changes match your AI ignore patterns — nothing to describe.
emptyStaged.unreadable: Nothing to describe — files whose names aren't readable text are always kept from AI.
emptyStaged.both: Nothing to describe — files whose names aren't readable text are always kept from AI, and the rest of the staged changes match your AI ignore patterns.

coAuthors.label: Co-authors
coAuthors.selfAlreadyCredited: That's you — the commit author is already credited.
coAuthors.allAdded: Everyone from this repo's history is already added.
coAuthors.noAuthors: No other authors found in this repo's history.

forcePush.title: Amending will require a force push
forcePush.description: This commit is already on {{upstream}}. Amending rewrites it, so your branch and the remote will diverge and you'll need to force push to update it. GitDesktop force pushes with --force-with-lease and, where your Git can check it, --force-if-includes (the pair won't overwrite others' work your branch doesn't include), but it still rewrites the branch's history.

disabled.pullRequestRequired: This branch requires changes via a pull request
disabled.commitMoved: The latest commit changed since you started amending
disabled.branchMoved: The checked-out branch changed since you started amending
